item.text: {"search_note":"I found good direct evidence for coordination in the economic bureaucracy, some cabinet management, and a few corrective interventions. I found weaker direct evidence on party machinery and territorial control outside protest/security episodes. The clearest negative material came from the August protest crackdown and digital-law pressure, which show that internal discipline often ran toward coercion rather than rights-constrained follow-through. So the best bounded reading is: Tinubu showed some real central administrative coordination, but internal discipline across security and information institutions was uneven and often coercive.","evidence":[{"title":"Comprehensive economic coordination system","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"March 27, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/","summary":"Tinubu created the PECC and EET, putting the finance minister, CBN governor, key ministers, governors, and private-sector figures into a rapid implementation structure with monitoring and evaluation duties. This is strong evidence of internal coordination and follow-through across economic ministries and institutions.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.4","8B.3"]},{"title":"Cash transfer resumption after fraud probe","publisher":"The Guardian Nigeria","date":"February 26, 2024","url":"https://guardian.ng/news/conditional-cash-transfer-to-resume-amid-probe/","summary":"Conditional cash transfers were resumed while the humanitarian ministry and NSIPA were under fraud investigation, after Tinubu had suspended the program in January. That suggests a willingness to interrupt, investigate, and restart a major delivery channel rather than let it drift without control.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.7","8B.4"]},{"title":"Broad social protection restarted","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"February 26, 2024","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-restarts-cash-transfers-to-cushion-hardship-caused-by-reforms-46031196/","summary":"The government approved the immediate resumption of cash transfers to 12 million vulnerable households as compensation for reform pain. This is positive evidence of follow-through from the center into a large social-protection rollout.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.7"]},{"title":"Procurement bureaucracy tightened","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"June 15, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/","summary":"Tinubu ordered the resignation of the BPP director-general as part of a reorganization meant to improve efficiency and transparency. That is direct evidence of presidential control over an implementing agency and an attempt to restore administrative discipline.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.4","8B.7"]},{"title":"Cabinet reshuffle as performance management","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"October 23, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigerias-tinubu-names-seven-ministers-sacks-five-in-cabinet-reshuffle/2325625/","summary":"Tinubu reshuffled the cabinet, sacking five ministers, appointing seven new ones, and swapping ten, while retaining finance, defence, and national planning. This is weak-to-moderate positive evidence that he was managing the cabinet as an executive team rather than merely freezing it or purging the core.","question_ids":["8B.5","8B.4","8B.3"]},{"title":"Dialogue-plus-deployment during protests","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"July 31, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"Security forces deployed in major cities while the government said it was open to dialogue. That shows coordination and active command, but also coercive readiness that undercuts the idea of clean, restraint-first control.","question_ids":["8B.5","2B.5","8B.3"]},{"title":"Treason charges against protesters","publisher":"Reuters via StreetInsider","date":"September 2, 2024","url":"https://www.streetinsider.com/Reuters/Nigeria%2Bcharges%2Bprotesters%2Bwith%2Btreason%2C%2Binciting%2Bmilitary/23675734.html","summary":"Prosecutors charged protesters with treason and inciting military mutiny after the August demonstrations. This is strong negative evidence for internal discipline because it shows coercive institutions being used to escalate against dissent rather than contain disorder with clear limits.","question_ids":["8B.5","2B.5","4B.4"]},{"title":"Cyber law pressure and self-censorship","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House found that the Cybercrimes Act continued to enable legal pressure on journalists and activists, while police were directed to monitor and prosecute “false information.” That is negative evidence that the administration was not fully maintaining restraint and institutional discipline in the information/control sphere.","question_ids":["8B.5","7B.1","4B.4"]}]}
